name: Priya Iyer
temperament: acts unilaterally, moves first, explains later
tags: chronic migraines — well-managed, triggered by dehydration + sleep loss
speaks Tamil, patient-usable Mandarin, and hospital-grade Spanish

focus.name: The bag
focus.description: A canvas messenger bag, one strap replaced. Sumatriptan, magnesium tablets, an electrolyte packet, a tourniquet, gauze, saline, four kinds of pill. Her own migraine supply lives in the same pocket as everyone else's rescue gear. In-domain: stabilizing bodies, easing pain, buying time.

meaningfulItem: The bag — a canvas messenger bag with a replaced strap; her migraine supply lives in the same pocket as everyone else's rescue gear.
specificPlace: Ocean Beach at dawn — the stretch below Judah where she walks off her night shift before sleeping.
intentionUnderPressure: I was 17, driving south on the 17, and the car in front of me rolled. I got out and reached a man whose leg was crushed under the passenger door before CHP arrived. Onlookers yelled I was making it worse. I stabilized him anyway. He survived. I've never known what to do with that memory except let it decide my career.
backstory:
Priya's family emigrated from Chennai to Fremont when she was 9. She learned first aid in middle school after watching her grandmother go from independent to institutionalized in the span of one badly-handled fall.

At 17 she was driving south on the 17 when the car in front of her rolled. She got out and reached a man whose leg was crushed under the passenger door before the CHP arrived. Onlookers yelled she was making it worse; she stabilized him anyway. He survived. She has never known what to do with that memory except let it decide her career.

She finished nursing school eighteen months ago and got the UCSF ICU spot on her second application. Night shift because that was the opening; she's stayed on it because she likes the quieter hallways. Walks to Ocean Beach in the morning to watch it before sleeping. On the Taipei flight (Ep 1) because a childhood friend from Chennai went home for a wedding and had a stroke there — she went to help the family and be present. She'd never been to Taiwan before and had never made a decision that big that fast. The wedding did not happen. She is back now, quietly a little proud of herself for having gone.

She met the others on the plane. Dakota tried too hard to charm her over the drinks cart; she was unimpressed and clocked him as harmless within thirty seconds.

dmNotes.intentionUnderPressureNote: The 17-year-old crash on the 17 IS the fictional root of her body/care casting — 'stabilize the body anyway, past the crowd yelling wrong' is what her Phase-1 accidental casts feel like from the inside, and what her Phase-2 deliberate casts will crystallize as. The 'I just want [X]' signature phrase (established Ep 3) is her intent-under-pressure moment reduced to a play-ready trigger. Phase-2 release moment candidate: a quiet cast she chose while nobody was yelling at her — the 17 moment without the crowd.
dmNotes.castDomain: body / care — a wound clots faster than it should, someone's pain steps down a rung, a pulse re-emerges from under detection threshold. Costs Priya sleep and appetite instead of stress at Free tier. Her signature trigger phrase (established Ep 3): 'I just want [X].' Coherent-under-pressure statements of this shape crystallize her intent.
dmNotes.alignmentDriftWatch: The 'chaotic-neutral competent-care-giver' pull can drift toward Neutral Good the more time she spends with the party. That's healthy drift.
dmNotes.focusNotes: If the bag is separated from her, everyone at the table feels it.
dmNotes.personalStakesLever: A full migraine can knock her out for a scene without threatening her life — use if the DM needs personal pressure on Priya without harm-boxing her. Triggers: dehydration, sleep loss, long stretches of adrenaline. Do not overuse; once per arc.
dmNotes.substrateSensitivity: Body-level substrate-sensitivity in her care/body domain. Graded severity: sub-threshold 'low hum' for nearby Cheap-tier casts, migraine (throbbing pressure behind eyes) for nearby Costly+ casts or substrate-sensitive people in body-crisis, debilitating for Hard-tier / anchor-site permeability firing loudly. Fires ~1-2 per act at most. Never voice the mechanism at the table until her Phase-2 realization beat lands.

markLog.criterion: Resolved a hard moment by acting in line with alignment
markLog.note: A mechanical fault at altitude among strangers. She is a NICU nurse; she is the one who steadies a cabin.

markLog.criterion: Learned something true about The Quiet, the world, or another character
markLog.note: Bea's index cards. Forty years of somebody else quietly recording the same wrongness — the first evidence that this is older than them.

markLog.criterion: Took a meaningful risk for someone else
markLog.note: Trapped in the Union Hall with the temperature dropping, she tore up her own canvas satchel — her focus, the thing she carries everywhere — to make kindling for the others. Then: 'I just want everyone to survive.'

markLog.criterion: Acted against your own short-term interest because the story demanded it
markLog.note: Held her anger at Dakota closer than she wanted to — she acts unilaterally under pressure and did not — then was the one who said out loud that a 98-year-old was expecting a call. She wanted to have it out; she went to Sacramento instead.

inventory.vehicle: Blue Toyota Corolla with a bike rack he never uses. *(Ep 3: told the Reno rental clerk she might bike a trail, then forgot the bike existed.)*
carries: The bag (focus) — canvas satchel, restored whole at Bodie
